result.summary: VERIFY_ONLY: G3 complete/cancel/undo receipts are consumable by the G4 persist Private Reality journal without bypassing World Commit authority. Complete path maps to apply_mutation (request_id + expected_world_revision=3) as local offline simulation only. Cancel is hard-gated and never journals mutation_applied. Undo maps to apply_compensation append with prior_receipt_id and history_erased=false. Persist never claims live World Commit success; G3 durable_mutation_applied remains false on the online/stub path. No product code changes required for G4 acceptance; non-blocking consumer adapter gaps listed for a later WO.

C5_product_changes_or_adapter_gaps.reason: Persist API + gates already accept the consumer contract demonstrated by P1 smoke against G3 ids/revision. Executor remains export-only handoff by design for G3. Wiring is a later consumer adapter WO, not a P2 product patch (VERIFY_ONLY; cannot write product).

consumer_adapter_gaps_for_later_wo.description: No product call from executor/g3_onboarding_slice to PersistModule after confirm. Future adapter should explicitly invoke local apply_mutation only for private_reality simulation after confirmed preview — never auto from unconfirmed preview.

Complete receipt nests mutation_class/actor under commit_request and lacks a full entity transform payload. Adapter should project commit_request fields + entity_recipe_id into apply_mutation shape (or rely on documented defaults: durable_world/create/cozy_house_small).

Undo prior_receipt_id points at G3 complete slice receipt_id (fb786347-…). apply_compensation requires that id in the journal receipt index. Adapter must either pass complete.receipt_id as apply_mutation.receipt_id, or rewrite undo.prior_receipt_id to the journal apply result receipt_id.
Undo must call apply_compensation; dumping undo into apply_mutation is rejected (use_apply_compensation). Documented contract only — no code change required for this verify.

After local journal apply, consumer UI/exports must keep online durable_mutation_applied=false / world_commit_invoked=false unless World Commit service actually runs. Optional local flag e.g. local_journal_applied may be added in a later WO without claiming server authority.
P1 notes PersistModule not yet wired into main scene mount tree; P3_CORE_RELOAD_VERIFY owns boot/reload integration check.
